title: Document answers (document-answers.json)
description: Private, per-project fill-in content, kept entirely separate from the shared /formats registry. Answers are keyed by the attrs.slotId that document-skeleton.json's fillIn nodes carry; format-registry/answers-merge.ts merges this file into the shared skeleton at export time to produce a complete document. Never stored under /formats — /formats is shared/general content only.

answers.description: Keyed by attrs.slotId. A value is either a plain string (wrapped as a single text run at merge time) or an array of ProseMirror inline nodes for richer content (marks, multiple runs).
